Thank you for following our page! Together we hope that we can continue the conversation about the future of the beautiful Great Lakes region. If you would like to learn more about LIGL please visit the following link: www.utoledo.edu/law/academic...

The LIGL also recently developed the Great Lakes Fellowship, which provides current University of Toledo College of Law students the opportunity to research and write about issues within the mission of the LIGL.

Welcome to the blog of the Legal Institute of the Great Lakes. The LIGL is a multidisciplinary research center located within the University of Toledo College of Law. LIGL is dedicated to supporting research, maintaining publications, and sponsoring conferences on issues related to the Great Lakes.
